title: All-Station Spatiotemporal and Graph Feature Store
mission: Use every valid station as a spatial sensor array, generating causal anomalies, gradients, group modes, propagation and disagreement features.
steps: For each station create latest-before-cutoff levels, changes, slopes and prior-only anomalies.
Generate T−Td, pressure tendency, repaired u/v wind and circular shifts.
Generate pairwise/group gradients: coastal-inland, north-south, east-west, urban-airport-marine, upwind-downwind.
Generate station ranks, rank reversals, disagreement and missingness.
Create graph adjacency from distance/elevation/coast role; fit graph/PCA modes inside each fold only.
Separate historical proxy features from exact-vintage live features.
Produce station contribution coverage and dropout profiles.
acceptance: All 36 ISD stations explicitly included or rejected with reason
failure: Historical availability unproven: features remain research-proxy while live-safe pipeline still built
